verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's manifesto makes a first-party promise to stay backwards-compatible "so that the existing code can drive value for years to come" (opentofu-docs-23). This is a documented compatibility commitment, but it is only a high-level principle, and no release-to-release upgrade guides appear in the evidence. The drop-in Terraform replacement claim (opentofu-docs-1) concerns compatibility with Terraform rather than between OpenTofu releases, so it adds only adjacent support. Missing for 10: per-release upgrade/migration guides, a formal versioning or compatibility policy (e.g. semver or deprecation guarantees), and independent corroboration that upgrades between OpenTofu versions are smooth.
